bounded_finding: OpenInference is useful as a non-authoritative semantic observability projection donor, especially post-hoc linked evaluator carriers, explicit annotator provenance and mask-before-sampler privacy. It must not replace F2-native broadcast/selection/plan/recipient/provenance identities. Random observer IDs, sampling/suppression gaps, generic taxonomy, privacy defaults and dependency cost make full runtime import unjustified at E2.
proposed_shape: F2 authoritative receipt/runpackage -> pure rebuildable projection -> OpenInference-compatible attributes/links -> optional exporter; no reverse canonical/effect/completion authority.
authority_note: Provenance mirror only; F2 claim/result surfaces and pending_research.sqlite retain their declared roles.
